witness: Acts 2:30 "that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne"
takes: So David's loins reach the child through the line Luke 3:31 gives, without the husband being the begetter.

witness: Matthew 1:20 "fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost"
takes: The "fear" is of taking her.

witness: Mark 7:8 "ye hold the tradition of men, [as] the washing of pots and cups"
takes: The matter of Mark 7:8-9 is washings and the keeping of tradition, and that is the matter it states.

witness: Hebrews 7:14 "For [it is] evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda"
takes: It is plain that he sprang out of Juda because Matthew 1:16 gives the house by Joseph and Luke 3:31 gives the seed by the woman.

witness: Matthew 1:24 "Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife"
takes: It fits the link.

witness: Genesis 48:5 "which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, [are] mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine"
takes: They stand in Jacob's house by his word, "[are] mine; as Reuben and Simeon".

witness: Numbers 1:2 "after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of [their] names"
takes: That is the reckoning by taking and naming.

witness: Jeremiah 18:8 "If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them."
takes: The rule of 18:8 is stated for "that nation" with its own condition, the turning.

witness: Haggai 2:23 "and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee"
takes: Haggai gives the signet to Zerubbabel, called "governor of Judah", and that is the office Haggai names.

witness: Haggai 2:23 "will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee"
takes: What is chosen is Zerubbabel himself, "my servant", and the office named is "governor", not one sitting upon the throne.

witness: Luke 2:4 "because he was of the house and lineage of David"
takes: The "because" gives Joseph's own reason for going up, namely his paternal descent.

witness: Luke 1:27 "To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David"
takes: The house of David is told here of Joseph.

witness: 1 Corinthians 15:38 "But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body."
takes: "His own body" is the body proper to the kind, and the kind is one flesh of men.

witness: Psalms 132:11 "Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne"
takes: David's fruit therefore reaches him as flesh through a woman of David's line.

witness: Leviticus 19:19 "Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind"
takes: The statute is addressed to "ye", Israel, about cattle, field and garment.

witness: Luke 1:36 "And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age"
takes: Mary's descent from David is carried by Luke 3:23-31, not by this row.

witness: John 6:42 "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know?"
takes: The speakers of "we know" are the murmurers, and they set that sonship against "I came down from heaven".

witness: Jeremiah 22:24 "though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence"
takes: It plucks the same man from the signet place before verse 30 closes the throne to his seed.

witness: Genesis 2:22 "And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman"
takes: What is born of her is of that kind.

witness: Colossians 2:8 "after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ"
takes: His resolve is the resolve of a man who has found a wife with child and does not count the child his.
